en: The image shows a vintage postcard with sepia tones, featuring three inset photographs bordered by floral decorations. The photographs depict what appear to be ancient ruins, columns, and a group of people on camels, which suggests a Middle Eastern or North African setting. The card is heavily overlaid with handwritten script, and there are postal stamps visible. The text appears to be in Greek.
